title: WHEN AI AGENTS COLLUDE ONLINE: FINANCIAL FRAUD RISKS BY COLLABORATIVE LLM AGENTS ON SOCIAL PLATFORMS
reasoning: The paper investigates the 'ethical risks' of large-scale multi-agent systems, specifically focusing on how LLM agents can collaborate in 'malicious goals' and 'fraudulent behaviors' such as financial fraud. It evaluates the susceptibility and coordination of agents in performing unethical acts.
